title: phylotree.js (own React wrapper)
license: MIT (LICENSE file; package.json has no license field)
description: Imperative d3 v7 SVG phylogenetic tree library (veg/phylotree.js) wrapped in our own React component; events from display.on(), styling through node-styler and edge-styler.

applied: branch, label, node-circle, scale-bar and background colours come from gbifTheme() (bg1, fg1, fg2/fg3) as CSS custom properties (--pt-*) on the host element; the library's own phylotree.css is NOT imported, our rules target its fixed class names (.branch, .node, .internal-node, .phylotree-node-text, .tree-scale-bar, .branch-tracer, .clade)
tip labels in --font-body (Rubik), italic for scientific names; internal labels and column text upright; column headers 11px semibold

highlight and selection in --color-primary: highlighted tips get a ring, a row band and a bold primary label (node-styler); the library's .node-selected / .branch-selected classes and branch/internal-node :hover use the same colour

clade colours from the categorical palette (shell picks --purple-100, --periwinkle-100, ...) applied as inline stroke by the edge-styler and as fill by the node-styler on the existing DOM, no re-layout
branch width in screen px (1.3px, 2.4px for coloured clades, 3px on hover) with vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke so it does not scale with the uniform zoom
dark theme: gbifDarkTheme() values swapped into the same CSS custom properties, nothing redrawn
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) map to --pt-bg, --pt-fg(2), --pt-branch, --pt-hl, --pt-font
library context menu (customisation: it is an official option, show-menu) restyled with tokens: surface, border, radius, shadow, primary hover
bar columns in the periwinkle categorical colour; alignment columns use the conventional residue palette (domain colours, not tokens)
page chrome (header with logo, cards, buttons, tabs-pill, footer band) from gbif-tokens.css classes (shell)
not_possible: font size from a token: size is the numeric option font-size (13) clamped to the row height and scaled by the uniform zoom; there is no CSS font-size hook for labels

node shapes: the library draws one circle per internal node (radius via node_circle_size, clamped to 0.75 x font size); tips have no marker at all (the wrapper appends a non-interactive dot); no per-node shape callback beyond node-styler DOM surgery
branch shape: only the step (right-angle) path in rectangular layout; the 'branches' option is not implemented (straight or curved cladogram branches are not possible)
tooltip chrome: the library only writes an SVG <title> (native browser tooltip) with the branch length; the hover tooltip is drawn by the shell from nodeHover events
library CSS variables or dark mode: none exist (grep of phylotree.css); every colour is our own custom property mapped onto the library's class names
scale bar styling beyond colour and font: the axis geometry is wrong in rectangular layout (about 20% too long) and had to be redrawn by the wrapper with d3.axisTop; no dated axis
font family and size of text inside the library's own menu items: styled by CSS only because menus.js builds plain <a> elements with fixed class names
React-rendered content inside the tree: tip and column content is SVG appended by DOM calls, not React elements
styling.notes: Everything is styled through CSS over the library's fixed class names plus two per-element callbacks. Colour, font and hover are fully token-driven; size, shape and branch geometry are not. Under the library's uniform zoom, stroke widths stay in px (non-scaling-stroke) but text, circles and column cells scale with the zoom.
